title: Worth the Buzz: DoorDash Names Top Local Coffee Shops for National Coffee Day
summary: From cold brew and pour-overs to breakfast staples, DoorDash is spotlighting the local coffee shops customers love, plus deals from Dunkin’ Donuts and Scooter's Coffee
body_markdown:
National Coffee Day is coming up on September 29, and DoorDash is marking the occasion by serving up a list of the **Top Coffee Shops for 2026*,** a celebratory list of top-rated small and medium-sized coffee shops on DoorDash. The list recognizes the standout small and medium-sized local coffee shops helping customers start their mornings, power through the afternoon, and everything in between.


## **Coffee's Big Year on DoorDash**


Coffee had a standout year on DoorDash in 2025, and the order data** shows exactly when customers were reaching for it most:


-


In 2025, there were **more than 80 million coffee orders placed on DoorDash** .


-


The **most popular time to order coffee was 9am** , and the **most popular day was Friday,** pointing to coffee's role as a morning ritual with an extra lift heading into the weekend.


-


The **busiest day of the year for coffee orders was Friday, December 19 which saw nearly 280,000 coffee orders** – more than any single day which may have been driven by holiday routines, gifting, and office ordering as the year wound down.


> *“National Coffee Day is a chance to celebrate the local coffee shops that are part of our everyday routines,” said* ***Ruth Isenstadt, Head of U.S. Restaurants at DoorDash.*** *“They’re the places that know your order, know their regulars, and become part of the neighborhood. This list celebrates some of the local favorites doing that every day in communities across the country.”*


## **Celebrating DoorDash's Top Local Coffee Shops**


Whether customers are craving a classic drip coffee, a specialty latte, a cold brew, or something paired with a pastry, these neighborhood shops make it easy to celebrate National Coffee Day on-demand.


Based on DoorDash data from July 2025 through July 2026, the list includes small and medium-sized coffee shops with fewer than 10 stores, at least 1,000 lifetime reviews, and the highest average consumer ratings during the measurement period.


From Alaska to Wisconsin and plenty of coffee shops in between, this list features local favorites including[Portland Coffee Roasters](https://www.doordash.com/store/974007) in Portland,[Base Coffee](https://www.doordash.com/store/599122) in Utah, and[Bobo's Cafe](https://www.doordash.com/store/1550330) in New York.
